newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Three Dubai, five Qua Iboe offers in India tender.
newsitem.headline: Three Dubai, five Qua Iboe offers in India tender.

text.p: Two cargoes of Dubai crude oil and five very large crude carriers (VLCC) of West African crude have been offered into the India tender to buy January lifting grades, traders said on Thursday.
The tender is expected to be awarded later on Thursday, a day ahead of the original schedule released by the state-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) earlier in November.
The tender was originally scheduled to close on Thursday and remain valid until Friday but traders said they have been notified the tender dates have been brought forward by 24 hours.

Traders said a major has offered a Dubai cargo at January half-month Dubai quotes plus 65 cents, on a free-on-board (fob) basis. Some traders said they heard the major had also offered a Dubai cargo on a Brent related pricing basis.
A U.S. trader has offered a Dubai cargo at January half month quotes plus 68 cents fob. Some sources said they heard the U.S. major had offered at plus 55 cents.
At least four VLCCs of Qua Iboe were offered, on a cost-nad-freight (c-and-f) basis, traders said.
A European trader offered at dated Brent plus $1.23 per barrel on a cost-and-freight basis and a Japanese trader offered at dated Brent plus $1.20.
A separate European trader offered at dated Brent plus $1.0893, traders said.
A U.S. major provided the lowest offer in price terms at dated Brent plus $1.05.
Traders said a French major offered a combination VLCC of Qua Iboe and Palanca at Bonny Light/Qua Iboe quotes plus 71 cents.
One Oman cargo was offered by a MidEast trader at MPM plus 33 cents.
